task.title: Hooks run concurrently instead of in the listed order
task.body:
We currently run each stage's hooks concurrently, one goroutine per hook. So when a stage has more than one hook they don't run in listed order, and a failing hook doesn't stop the ones after it. The spec requires both: hooks "MUST be called in the listed order" ([config.md](https://github.com/opencontainers/runtime-spec/blob/main/config.md#posix-platform-hooks)), and a failing `createRuntime`/`createContainer`/`startContainer` hook MUST stop the container ([runtime.md](https://github.com/opencontainers/runtime-spec/blob/main/runtime.md#lifecycle)).

The sequential path already exists in the tree behind a toggle. Since the concurrency only matters when a stage has 2+ hooks, exactly the case it gets wrong, we can just run them sequentially and drop the concurrent path, which also retires the panic #445 fixed inside it.

spec: Hooks run concurrently instead of in the listed order
